title: Diamond Elite Card: Invitation-Only Membership - How to Qualify
summary: This document explains eligibility for the Rho-Bank Diamond Elite Card, an invitation-only membership, including the guideline to maintain a credit score of at least $780. It details how invitations are extended (creditworthiness, timely payments, low credit utilization, verifiable income, and relationship depth) and advises on actions to strengthen candidacy and respond to time-limited invitations.
